summary: Threshold, ratio, knee, attack, release, makeup, auto makeup, mix and lookahead carry over in their units onto Neo Comp's Clean character.

rules.why: Neo Comp looks ahead up to 5 ms; longer lookaheads are cut to 5 ms.

unmapped.why: Neo Comp's characters each have their own detector (Clean is peak); Pedal Comp's RMS detection has no exact counterpart, so an RMS setting reacts faster after the move.

remarks: Both are feed-forward compressors with a soft knee, but their detectors and gain smoothing differ: steady material matches closely, transients less so.
Pedal Comp's release speeds up as the level falls fast (program-dependent); Neo Comp's Auto release is the nearer match, so the mapping turns it on.

tolerance.measured: rebuzz-headless (Linux), Neo Poly noise notes at four velocities through it, each side read against its input: −0.7 dB (−24 dB, 4:1, 5 ms, 100 ms), +0.2 … +0.4 dB (−30 dB, 8:1, 1 ms, 300 ms, 6 dB knee), −0.6 dB at its defaults; third octaves within 0.7 dB. With Neo Comp's Auto release off it came out 1.3 dB quieter (Pedal Comp's release is program-dependent)
